newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian state television gets new boss.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian state television gets new boss.

text.p: Nigerian military ruler General Sani Abacha has appointed a new director-general of the Nigerian Television Authority (NTA), the state network said.
It said in a statement on Monday that Patrick Ityohegh, a U.S.-educated broadcaster had succeeded Mohammed Ibrahim.
NTA has more than two dozen television stations scattered around the vast West African nation and faces competition from private broadcasters recently granted licences.
Ityohegh, who has worked in different areas of broadcasting over the last 30 years, is famous in Nigeria for creating humorous programmes.
